Heartbeat advanced monotonically (polls 7->19->47->64 then 3->9 on a fresh watcher), poll_failures 0 throughout, written atomically at mode 0600 and carrying the input layer's OWN counters — which is what distinguishes 'alive and quiet' from 'silently dead', the failure that hid through the whole of epic #667. stall_warning driven directly: None inside its window, fires past it, never fires on a working pane; heartbeat_due is >= not > per the Step-8a finding.

claim: handoff runs live in fresh-session mode on a throwaway
note: MOVED INCONCLUSIVE->BLOCKED, and the change of blocker is the finding. Run 1 was INCONCLUSIVE because project_switched did not complete — the #682 bug. Run 2 never reaches project_switched at all: the ladder refuses at step 0 with 'no handoff: no durable launcher armed (launch mode herdr)'. fresh_session_available requires the CALLER to assert --launcher-armed AND --fresh-launch-supported, and launcher_lib.py:2156 is explicit that absence must not read as support. Run on a scratch driver-state with a throwaway anchor pane, so nothing real was touched. What #682 demonstrably DID fix is visible in the contract: --project is now REQUIRED on the handoff subcommand.
